findings.desc: In primary astrocytes from APOE-targeted replacement mice, ApoE4 was associated with greater ARF6 protein expression and significantly lower plasma-membrane ABCA1 than ApoE3, while ABCA1 mRNA and total ABCA1 protein did not differ, indicating ARF6-related trapping of ABCA1 away from the cell surface.
findings.quote: We found greater protein levels of ARF6 in ApoE4 primary astrocytes compared with ApoE3 primary astrocytes
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (increased ARF6 expression and less ABCA1 at the astrocyte plasma membrane)
findings.exp_system: Primary astrocytes from human APOE3- and APOE4-targeted-replacement mice; membrane fractionation and Western blot for ABCA1 and ARF6

findings.desc: In HeLa cells expressing GFP-tagged ABCA1, recombinant ApoE4 (0.2 µM, 30 min) increased ABCA1 colocalization with the late-endosome/lysosome marker LAMP2 and decreased colocalization with the recycling-endosome marker Rab11 compared with recombinant ApoE3, showing ABCA1 is diverted from recycling endosomes into late endosomes and away from the plasma membrane.
findings.quote: Greater colocalization of ABCA1 with the late endosome marker LAMP2 and lower colocalization with the recycling endosome marker Rab11 were observed in cells treated with rApoE4 compared with rApoE3
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (ABCA1 diverted from Rab11 recycling endosomes to LAMP2 late endosomes, impairing its recycling to the membrane)
findings.exp_system: HeLa cells transfected with GFP-tagged ABCA1 treated with 0.2 µM recombinant ApoE3 or ApoE4; confocal colocalization with LAMP2 and Rab11

findings.desc: ApoE4 primary astrocytes showed lower ABCA1-mediated cholesterol efflux than ApoE3 astrocytes at 4 h and 24 h, and siRNA knockdown of ARF6 in ApoE4 astrocytes significantly increased cholesterol efflux at both time points, causally linking ARF6 to the ApoE4 trafficking defect.
findings.quote: Knockdown of ARF6 by siRNA resulted in significant increase in cholesterol efflux in ApoE4 primary astrocytes after 4 and 24 h
findings.summary: (ARF6 knockdown in APOE4 astrocytes) -> (increased ABCA1-mediated cholesterol efflux)
findings.exp_system: Primary astrocytes from APOE3- and APOE4-targeted-replacement mice labelled with 3H-cholesterol; ARF6 siRNA knockdown in ApoE4 astrocytes; cholesterol efflux assay

findings.desc: In primary rat cortical neurons exposed to cell-derived ApoE particles and Reelin, Apoer2 rapidly recycled back to the cell surface in the presence of ApoE3 but its reappearance was greatly delayed with ApoE4, while receptors that do not bind ApoE (insulin receptor, transferrin receptor, Lrp1, Ldlr) were not significantly affected.
findings.quote: While Apoer2 quickly recycled in the presence of ApoE3, its reappearance on the cell surface was greatly delayed in the presence of ApoE4
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (delayed Apoer2 recycling back to the neuronal cell surface)
findings.exp_system: Primary rat cortical neurons treated with cell-derived recombinant ApoE3 or ApoE4 particles plus Reelin; cell-surface biotinylation recycling assay and immunoblot

findings.desc: The NHE inhibitor EMD87580 progressively restored normal surface recycling of Apoer2 in ApoE4-treated primary neurons in a dose-dependent manner, and at 3 µM completely neutralized the ApoE4 effect on Apoer2 recycling, consistent with endosomal acidification releasing the ApoE4 recycling block.
findings.quote: Increasing concentrations progressively restored normal surface recycling of Apoer2 in the presence of ApoE4
findings.summary: (NHE inhibition by EMD87580) -> (restored Apoer2 surface recycling in APOE4 neurons)
findings.exp_system: Primary rat cortical neurons treated with ApoE4-conditioned medium and Reelin with or without EMD87580; cell-surface biotinylation and immunoblot

findings.desc: Genetic inhibition of NHE6 was sufficient to reverse the block: of shRNAs against vesicular NHEs (1 and 5-9), only NHE6-specific shRNAs completely restored Apoer2 expression at the plasma membrane in ApoE4-treated neurons, and the same NHE6 knockdown completely restored surface expression of the co-endocytosed AMPA and NMDA glutamate receptors (Fig 6).
findings.quote: only NHE6-specific shRNAs were able to completely restore Apoer2 expression at the plasma membrane in the presence of ApoE4
findings.summary: (NHE6 knockdown) -> (complete restoration of Apoer2 and glutamate receptor surface recycling in APOE4 neurons)
findings.exp_system: Primary rat cortical neurons with lentiviral shRNA knockdown of NHE6 (three constructs), treated with ApoE4-conditioned medium and Reelin; cell-surface biotinylation and immunoblot

findings.desc: In primary mouse cortical neurons, endocytosed ApoE4 was retained in intracellular compartments at all chase time points and its release back into the medium was markedly delayed compared with ApoE2 and ApoE3, confirming that impaired recycling of ApoE4 itself occurs in primary neurons.
findings.quote: Substantially more ApoE4 was retained in intracellular compartments at all time points, confirming that impaired recycling of ApoE4 also occurs in primary neurons
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (impaired ApoE recycling with intracellular retention in neurons)
findings.exp_system: Primary embryonic mouse cortical neurons incubated with naturally secreted ApoE2, ApoE3 or ApoE4 lipoproteins (3 µg/mL); suramin wash and 30-120 min chase, immunoprecipitation and immunoblot

findings.desc: ApoE4, but not ApoE2 or ApoE3, significantly decreased neuronal surface expression of Apoer2 in cell-surface biotinylation assays, and upon Reelin stimulation ApoE4 produced a dramatic, highly significant reduction of Apoer2 at the neuronal cell surface, consistent with sequestration of the receptor in intracellular recycling compartments.
findings.quote: ApoE4 led to a dramatic and statistically highly significant reduction of Apoer2 at the neuronal cell surface
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (reduced neuronal surface Apoer2 via intracellular sequestration)
findings.exp_system: Primary cultured neurons treated with ApoE isoforms (3 µg/mL) with or without Reelin (2 µg/mL); cell-surface biotinylation and anti-Apoer2 immunoblot

findings.desc: ApoE4 reduced neuronal surface expression of NMDA and AMPA receptors as well as Apoer2 by sequestration in intracellular compartments, and almost completely abolished Reelin-enhanced NMDA receptor-dependent Ca2+ influx at 3 µg/mL, linking the receptor recycling defect to loss of glutamate receptor function.
findings.quote: ApoE4 reduces neuronal surface expression of Apoer2, a dual function receptor for ApoE and for Reelin, as well as NMDA and AMPA receptors by sequestration in intracellular compartments
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (reduced surface NMDA and AMPA receptors via intracellular sequestration)
findings.exp_system: Primary cultured neurons treated with ApoE isoforms with Reelin stimulation; cell-surface biotinylation of GluA1, GluA2/3 and GluN2B and fura-2 Ca2+ imaging

findings.desc: In H4 neuroglioma cells, wild-type HAP1 cells and human APOE-knockout iPSC-derived astrocytes, lipidated ApoE3 and ApoE4 (but not ApoE2) significantly reduced cell-surface LDLR after 1 day, which the authors interpret as impaired LDLR recycling accompanying LDLR-mediated ApoE uptake; the recycling contrast is against ApoE2, not between ApoE3 and ApoE4.
findings.quote: In H4, WT HAP1, and APOE KO iAstrocytes, incubation with lipApoE3/E4 significantly reduced surface LDLR relative to lipApoE2, revealing impaired LDLR recycling accompanying increased LDLR-mediated lipApoE uptake
findings.summary: (APOE2 -> APOE3/APOE4) -> (reduced surface LDLR / impaired LDLR recycling)
findings.exp_system: H4 neuroglioma cells, WT HAP1 cells and human APOE-KO iPSC-derived astrocytes treated with POPC-lipidated ApoE (10 µg/mL, 1 d); cell-surface LDLR immunostaining and confocal quantification

findings.desc: CONTRADICTING: For the hypothesis's specific APOE4-versus-APOE3 comparison, this paper reports no LDLR-recycling difference: the recycling defect was observed with lipidated ApoE3 and ApoE4 alike, and only ApoE2, whose LDLR binding is impaired, avoided it, so ApoE3 behaved like ApoE4 rather than recycling LDLR normally.
findings.quote: impaired low-density lipoprotein (LDL) receptor (LDLR) binding of lipidated ApoE2 (lipApoE2) avoids LDLR recycling defects observed with lipApoE3/E4
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (no difference in LDLR recycling defect; both isoforms differ from APOE2) [CONTRADICTS]
findings.exp_system: Human cellular models (H4, HAP1, APOE-KO iPSC-derived astrocytes and human neurons) treated with lipidated ApoE isoforms; LDLR binding, surface LDLR and recycling readouts (abstract-level statement)

findings.desc: After 1 day of pre-treatment, lipidated ApoE3/E4 redistributed LDLR from the cell surface to endolysosomes and nearly abolished subsequent DiI-LDL uptake in H4 cells, whereas ApoE2 pre-treatment modestly enhanced LDL uptake, a functional consequence of the failed LDLR recycling.
findings.quote: Taken together, increased LDLR-mediated uptake of lipApoE3/E4, coupled with inefficient dissociation of LDLR from lipApoE upon internalization, results in redistribution of cell surface LDLR to endolysosomes
findings.summary: (APOE2 -> APOE3/APOE4) -> (surface LDLR redistributed to endolysosomes and LDL uptake nearly abolished)
findings.exp_system: H4 neuroglioma cells pre-treated 1 d with POPC-lipidated ApoE (10 µg/mL) then DiI-LDL uptake assay; LDLR and LAMP1 co-immunostaining
